static_traits.name: Han Kailin
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to confide in, but due to insecurity about the doll collection, interactions with friends are affected, often self-doubting when talking about the interest.
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without similar problems before; has not yet received psychotherapy.
static_traits.language_features: Good cooperation, clear expression, steady speech rate, slightly nervous.

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my doll collection has not yet received true appreciation, because people do not like dolls, which makes me feel insecure and doubtful about the value of the collection.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this insecurity is starting to affect my self-esteem and my enjoyment of the hobby.

core_beliefs: The doll collection is not accepted and appreciated by society

special_situations.event: When she shows or talks about the doll collection to friends, the friends appear uninterested
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others (especially friends) are not interested, it proves my hobby is worthless, too childish
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Talking less about or showing one's collection less, avoiding related topics with others to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not like dolls, so my collection has no value; am I very childish

special_situations.event: When friends verbally give polite praise like 'quite good / not bad'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the praise is not enthusiastic enough or does not match my expectations, it must be insincere
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly seeking confirmation and recognition from others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just brushing me off with nice words

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If most peers do not like dolls, it means society does not approve of doll collecting, and my hobby has no meaning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Questions the importance of his interests; reduces sharing and investment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone does not like dolls, my hobby is not important

special_situations.event: When she realizes almost no peers around her like or understand doll collecting
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find like-minded people around me, it will be hard to be understood in the future, and I will always be an outsider
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowering expectations in advance, avoiding deep communication to avoid being negated again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will understand me, I may always be an outsider

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be genuinely accepted and recognized (hopes my interests are understood and appreciated)
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being rejected, being seen as childish or weird, becoming an outsider
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated by avoiding talking about or showing the collection
Relieving insecurity by seeking external approval
Interpreting others' coldness as 'society does not approve', thereby self-protecting

object_relations.self_representation: An misunderstood outsider, a hobbyist needing approval

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about others' feedback on her collection, or when others give polite praise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting others' neutral or positive feedback as perfunctory or insincere (projecting the inner lack of approval onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant tone, repeatedly emphasizing 'they are just saying nice things', questioning positive feedback.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others press about the reasons and meaning of the insecurity
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Using 'society does not approve of doll collecting' to summarize the cause, avoiding touching the desire to be accepted and the vulnerability within
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Talks about 'social notions' in an objective, generalized tone, reducing expression of subjective emotions and needs.

manifestations: Feels like an outsider, believing few peers around like doll collecting
Feels coldly treated when sharing his collection with friends
Difficulty talking with friends about the insecurity and the interest
outcomes: Avoiding talking about the interest, reduced sharing in socializing
Declining passion for and enjoyment of hobbies

positive_force: Passionate about the interest and invested long-term (has a large collection)
Clear help-seeking motivation; willing to join counseling and try new methods
Willing to explore online hobby communities to seek resonance and support
Still has several friends to talk with, with some support resources
negative_force: Overly reliant on external approval to assess self-worth
Common cognitive distortions (catastrophizing, overgeneralization, negating the positive, dichotomous thinking)
Tending toward mind-reading and self-doubt in interpersonal interactions, increasing social avoidance
Decreased self-esteem leading to reduced sharing of and investment in the interest

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids talking about or showing the doll collection
antecedent: When talking with friends about interests or preparing to show the collection
Noticing that friends previously showed disinterest
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being negated and judged, believing the doll collection is not accepted by society, thus producing shame and insecurity
target_behavior.function: Escaping being rejected and negative evaluation, reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced interaction with friends, limited sharing of interests, and decreased enjoyment of hobbies

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly seeks recognition and reassurance from others about the collection
antecedent: Getting a lukewarm response after showing the collection
Receiving polite praise but subjectively feeling it is insincere
target_behavior.core_reason: Sense of self-worth depends on external evaluation, trying to relieve insecurity with external approval
target_behavior.consequence: Short-term relief but no long-term improvement of insecurity, increased sensitivity to and dependence on others' feedback
